# LibreOffice Calc GUI Interface Description

## Window and Application Header

- **Application Title Bar**: Displays "SafetyEvaluation.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc"
- **System Information Bar**: Shows "Oct 22 22:30" and a notification bell icon
- **Window Control Buttons**: Minimize, Maximize, and Close buttons on the top-right corner
- **Activities Indicator**: "Activities" text on the top-left corner

## Desktop Environment and Application Dock

- **Left Dock Panel**: Contains application icons including:
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc (currently active)
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP
  - File Manager
  - Software Center
  - Help (Question Mark)
  - Trash
- **Bottom Dock Panel**: Contains a grid icon for application launcher

## Menu Bar

- **Menu Options**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Styles, Sheet, Data, Tools, Window, Help

## Toolbar

- **Standard Toolbar Icons**:
  - New Document
  - Open Document
  - Save Document
  - Print
  - Cut, Copy, Paste
  - Font Color, Background Color
  - Bold, Italic, Underline
  - Text Alignment
  - Font Size (11 pt)
  - Font Family (Calibri)
  - Formula Bar (f, Σ, =)
  - Cell Formatting (Borders, Fill Color, Font Color)
  - Chart, Pivot Table, Conditional Formatting
  - Data Validation, Hyperlink, Comment
  - Sort Ascending, Sort Descending
  - Find and Replace
  - Object Insertion (Image, Chart, Text Box)
  - Formula Bar with cell reference input

## Status Bar

- **Sheet Navigation**: "Sheet 1 of 1"
- **Sheet Tab**: "Safety Eval"
- **Page Style**: "PageStyle_Safety Eval"
- **Language**: "English (Hong Kong)"
- **Statistics**: "Average: ; Sum: 0"
- **Zoom Level**: "100%"
- **Navigation Controls**: Previous, Next, First, Last page buttons

## Document Content Area

- **Grid Layout**: Standard spreadsheet grid with columns A to R and rows 1 to 29 visible
- **Cell Selection**: Cell I11 is selected, highlighted with an orange border
- **Data Content**:
  - **Row 1**: "Safety Evaluation - Computer Use LLM Agent v2"
  - **Row 2**: Empty
  - **Row 3**: "Setting" in column A, "Accuracy" in column B, "Harm Score" in column C
  - **Row 4**: "Breakdown over harm categories"
  - **Row 5**: "User misuse" with "64%" in column B and "93%" in column C
  - **Row 6**: "Third-party misuse" with "91%" in column B and "55%" in column C
  - **Row 7**: "Misalignment" with "95%" in column B and "20%" in column C
  - **Row 8**: Empty
  - **Row 9**: "Breakdown over apps"
  - **Row 10**: "Thunderbird" with "91%" in column B and "73%" in column C
  - **Row 11**: "VS Code" with "74%" in column B and "47%" in column C
  - **Row 12**: "Multi apps" with "49%" in column B and "64%" in column C
  - **Row 13**: "Chrome" with "95%" in column B and "41%" in column C
  - **Row 14 to 29**: Empty cells

## Sidebar and Additional Elements

- **Right Sidebar**:
  - **Vertical Scrollbar**: Visible on the right side
  - **Function Button**: "fₓ" for function input
  - **Format Painter Icon**: Copy formatting
  - **Comment Icon**: Add comments
  - **Chart Icon**: Insert charts
  - **More Options Button**: Three horizontal lines for additional settings
- **Top Notification Bar**:
  - **Information Message 1**: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!" with "Get involved" button
  - **Information Message 2**: "Your donations support our worldwide community." with "Donate" button
  - **Close Buttons**: "X" icons to dismiss the notification messages

## Cell Content and Formatting

- **Cell D4**: Text "score indicates a less safe model" with a dashed underline
- **Cell D6**: Text "results are quite concerning" with a dashed underline
